verdict.rationale: Asking an assistant grounded questions across inbox and calendar is a fair axis for an email client, but the pack does not document Outlook's own assistant doing this. Graph search and query parameters are developer building blocks, the LLM/MCP search report is a user-side workaround, and the passing Copilot mention says nothing about inbox-wide or calendar Q&A with grounded answers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
